component.name: subfeed
component.summary: Your YouTube subscriptions, and nothing else

description.p: subfeed plays the YouTube channels you follow, newest first, in a quiet player built for the Linux desktop. There's no Google account, no recommendations and no autoplay.

ul.li: Import your subscriptions from Google Takeout, or add channels by name
Shorts stay in a view of their own, never mixed into the feed
A keyboard-first player with chapters, captions and resume
Save a video's transcript as a Markdown note, ready for Obsidian
Battery-friendly: hardware decoding, and quality that follows your power state
Media keys, desktop notifications for new videos, and a background refresh

description.p: Your subscriptions and history stay in a local database. subfeed is not affiliated with YouTube or Google; it plays public videos through yt-dlp.
